subject: [PATCH v4 01/19] selftests/mm: raise the khugepaged test-case cap

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch without raising any concerns.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch raises the maximum number of test cases in the khugepaged selftest from 64 to 256, allowing for more tests to be run without aborting the suite prematurely.
